title: Notion Plus to self-hosted SiYuan
summary: SiYuan runs on almost nothing. At one seat, that still may not be enough to beat paying Notion.

you_lose: Real-time collaboration — SiYuan is built for one person
A polished web app; SiYuan is a desktop-first tool with a server mode
you_gain: Block-level linking and backlinks that Notion does not do as well
Local Markdown files you own outright
A binary small enough to run on the cheapest box any provider sells

caveats: We expect this page to say stay, and it is here for that reason. One seat of Notion Plus is $120 a year, which is very hard to beat once your own hours are counted.
SiYuan is single-user by design. If anyone else needs access, this comparison does not apply to you.
Some SiYuan features are behind a paid cloud subscription of its own. The self-hosted core does not include them.
